listing_shares.notes: Input recovered from the previous stored valuation and its reference price.

revenue.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

net_income.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

free_cash_flow.notes: Operating cash flow TTM minus capex TTM. Capex is treated as a positive cash outflow.

debt.notes: Debt computed as sum of SEC debt components: LongTermDebtCurrent, LongTermDebtNoncurrent.

cash.notes: Latest SEC cash or cash-and-equivalent balance fact.

ebitda.notes: Input recovered from the previous stored valuation and its reference price.

forward_eps_public.notes: Yahoo expected EPS per listed share in USD; estimate methodology is not independently verified.

forward_eps_proxy.notes: Saved trailing EPS per listed share grown by 3-year EPS CAGR; not analyst consensus.

revenue_growth_yoy.notes: Quarterly revenue YoY growth for Q3 versus the same fiscal quarter last year.

revenue_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter 3-year CAGR computed from SEC Q3 revenue facts. Latest quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Prior-year quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. eps_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter diluted EPS 3-year CAGR computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

free_cash_flow.notes: Latest-quarter free_cash_flow: Quarterly free cash flow computed as operating cash flow minus capex.

fcf_margin.notes: Free cash flow TTM divided by revenue TTM, expressed as a percentage.

roe.notes: Latest-quarter roe: Annualized quarterly net income divided by quarter-end equity.

roic.notes: Latest-quarter roic: Proxy annualized quarterly ROIC: operating income divided by quarter-end invested capital. No tax adjustment is applied.

cash.notes: Latest SEC cash or cash-and-equivalent balance fact.

debt.notes: Debt computed as sum of SEC debt components: LongTermDebtCurrent, LongTermDebtNoncurrent.

debt_to_equity.notes: Latest debt divided by latest stockholders' equity.

eps_gaap_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

revenue_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

net_income_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

operating_cash_flow_ttm.notes: Latest annual SEC fact used because a same-year quarterly TTM bridge was unavailable.

capex_ttm.notes: Latest annual SEC fact used because a same-year quarterly TTM bridge was unavailable. Negative source value normalized to positive cash outflow.

gross_profit_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

cost_of_revenue_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

operating_income_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

shares_diluted.notes: Diluted shares computed from annual SEC net income divided by annual diluted EPS; not a live shares-outstanding feed.

market_cap.notes: Current price multiplied by saved listing share count, including its ADR adjustment.

revenue_growth_yoy.notes: Quarterly revenue YoY growth for Q2 versus the same fiscal quarter last year.

revenue_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter 3-year CAGR computed from reported Q2 revenue facts. Latest quarter: Reported single-quarter issuer fact. Prior-year quarter: Reported single-quarter issuer fact. Q2/Q3 single-quarter values may be derived from year-to-date 10-Q/6-K facts; Q4 may be derived from annual facts minus Q3 year-to-date facts.

eps_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_gaap_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS 3-year CAGR computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

free_cash_flow.notes: Latest-quarter free_cash_flow: Quarterly free cash flow computed as operating cash flow minus capex.

roe.notes: Latest-quarter roe: Annualized quarterly net income divided by quarter-end equity.

roic.notes: Latest-quarter roic: Proxy annualized quarterly ROIC: operating income divided by quarter-end invested capital. No tax adjustment is applied.

cash.notes: Latest SEC cash or cash-and-equivalent balance fact.

debt.notes: Latest available SEC debt fact. This may include capital/finance lease obligations depending on the SEC tag.

debt_to_equity.notes: Latest debt divided by latest stockholders' equity.

known_context_gaps: SEC filing archive exhibit details were skipped for batch collection scalability.
company_context.notes: Company context is collected from SEC submissions metadata. Per-filing archive exhibit lookups were skipped for batch collection scalability. The app does not classify the news as good or bad.

data_gaps: Fundamentals were normalized from Yahoo Finance statement tables rather than SEC companyfacts; statement rows are open/free vendor data and may lag issuer filings.

SEC companyfacts uses IFRS taxonomy. Foreign-currency fundamentals are supported; current valuation can use an explicit FX and ADR-ratio bridge, while historical valuation still needs historical FX handling.
Annual EPS series may cross stock-split accounting periods; use eps_diluted_computed and split-adjusted history with care.
Company-specific SEC filing context was unavailable from the deterministic provider.
Checked Yahoo statement tables for missing same-currency calendar-quarter fundamentals; retained overlapping SEC facts and calculated related metrics together.

free_cash_flow.notes: Latest-quarter free_cash_flow: Quarterly free cash flow computed as operating cash flow minus capex.

fcf_margin.notes: Free cash flow TTM divided by revenue TTM, expressed as a percentage.

roe.notes: Latest-quarter roe: Annualized quarterly net income divided by quarter-end equity.

roic.notes: Latest-quarter roic: Proxy annualized quarterly ROIC: operating income divided by quarter-end invested capital. No tax adjustment is applied.

cash.notes: Latest SEC cash or cash-and-equivalent balance fact.

debt.notes: Debt computed as sum of SEC debt components: LongTermDebtCurrent, LongTermDebtNoncurrent.

debt_to_equity.notes: Latest debt divided by latest stockholders' equity.

revenue_ttm.notes: Latest annual SEC fact used because a same-year quarterly TTM bridge was unavailable.

capex_ttm.notes: Latest annual SEC fact used because a same-year quarterly TTM bridge was unavailable. Negative source value normalized to positive cash outflow.

gross_profit_ttm.notes: Gross profit computed as revenue TTM minus cost of revenue TTM.

shares_diluted.notes: Latest diluted weighted-average share count from SEC companyfacts; not a live shares-outstanding feed.

market_cap.notes: Current price multiplied by saved listing share count, including its ADR adjustment.

revenue_growth_yoy.notes: Quarterly revenue YoY growth for Q1 versus the same fiscal quarter last year.

revenue_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter 3-year CAGR computed from reported Q1 revenue facts. Latest quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Prior-year quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Q2/Q3 single-quarter values may be derived from year-to-date 10-Q/6-K facts; Q4 may be derived from annual facts minus Q3 year-to-date facts.

eps_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_gaap_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS 3-year CAGR computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

free_cash_flow.notes: Latest-quarter free_cash_flow: Quarterly free cash flow computed as operating cash flow minus capex.

roe.notes: Latest-quarter roe: Annualized quarterly net income divided by quarter-end equity.

roic.notes: Latest-quarter roic: Proxy annualized quarterly ROIC: operating income divided by quarter-end invested capital. No tax adjustment is applied.

cash.notes: Latest SEC cash or cash-and-equivalent balance fact.

debt.notes: Latest available SEC debt fact. This may include capital/finance lease obligations depending on the SEC tag.

debt_to_equity.notes: Latest debt divided by latest stockholders' equity.

days_to_next_earnings.notes: Days until the next expected earnings release window (2026-11-04) from Yahoo Finance/yfinance. This is an open/free market-calendar estimate and can change before the company confirms the date.

change_1d.notes: Price performance computed from open/free daily close history.

revenue_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

net_income_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

operating_cash_flow_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

capex_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

gross_profit_ttm.notes: Gross profit computed as revenue TTM minus cost of revenue TTM.

cost_of_revenue_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

operating_income_ttm.notes: Proxy operating income computed as gross profit TTM minus SEC R&D and SG&A expense components.

shares_diluted.notes: Latest diluted weighted-average share count from SEC companyfacts; not a live shares-outstanding feed.

market_cap.notes: Current price multiplied by saved listing share count, including its ADR adjustment.

revenue_growth_yoy.notes: Quarterly revenue YoY growth for Q2 versus the same fiscal quarter last year.

revenue_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter 3-year CAGR computed from SEC Q2 revenue facts. Latest quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Prior-year quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Q2/Q3 single-quarter values may be derived from year-to-date 10-Q/6-K facts; Q4 may be derived from annual facts minus Q3 year-to-date facts.

eps_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter diluted EPS 3-year CAGR computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

free_cash_flow.notes: Latest-quarter free_cash_flow: Quarterly free cash flow computed as operating cash flow minus capex.

fcf_margin.notes: Free cash flow TTM divided by revenue TTM, expressed as a percentage.

roe.notes: Latest-quarter roe: Annualized quarterly net income divided by quarter-end equity.

roic.notes: Latest-quarter roic: Proxy annualized quarterly ROIC: operating income divided by quarter-end invested capital. No tax adjustment is applied.

cash.notes: Latest SEC cash or cash-and-equivalent balance fact.

debt.notes: Debt computed as sum of SEC debt components: DebtCurrent, LongTermDebtNoncurrent.

debt_to_equity.notes: Latest debt divided by latest stockholders' equity.

revenue_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

net_income_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

operating_cash_flow_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

capex_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

gross_profit_ttm.notes: Latest annual SEC fact used because a same-year quarterly TTM bridge was unavailable.

cost_of_revenue_ttm.notes: Latest annual SEC fact used because a same-year quarterly TTM bridge was unavailable.

operating_income_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

shares_diluted.notes: Latest diluted weighted-average share count from SEC companyfacts; not a live shares-outstanding feed.

market_cap.notes: Current price multiplied by saved listing share count, including its ADR adjustment.

revenue_growth_yoy.notes: Quarterly revenue YoY growth for Q2 versus the same fiscal quarter last year.

revenue_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter 3-year CAGR computed from SEC Q2 revenue facts. Latest quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Prior-year quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Q2/Q3 single-quarter values may be derived from year-to-date 10-Q/6-K facts; Q4 may be derived from annual facts minus Q3 year-to-date facts.

eps_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_gaap_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS 3-year CAGR computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

revenue_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

net_income_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

operating_cash_flow_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

capex_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

gross_profit_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

cost_of_revenue_ttm.notes: Latest annual SEC fact used because a same-year quarterly TTM bridge was unavailable.

operating_income_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

shares_diluted.notes: Latest diluted weighted-average share count from SEC companyfacts; not a live shares-outstanding feed.

market_cap.notes: Current price multiplied by saved listing share count, including its ADR adjustment.

revenue_growth_yoy.notes: Quarterly revenue YoY growth for Q1 versus the same fiscal quarter last year.

revenue_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter 3-year CAGR computed from SEC Q1 revenue facts. Latest quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Prior-year quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Q2/Q3 single-quarter values may be derived from year-to-date 10-Q/6-K facts; Q4 may be derived from annual facts minus Q3 year-to-date facts.

eps_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter diluted EPS 3-year CAGR computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

free_cash_flow.notes: Latest-quarter free_cash_flow: Quarterly free cash flow computed as operating cash flow minus capex.

fcf_margin.notes: Free cash flow TTM divided by revenue TTM, expressed as a percentage.

roe.notes: Latest-quarter roe: Annualized quarterly net income divided by quarter-end equity.

roic.notes: Latest-quarter roic: Proxy annualized quarterly ROIC: operating income divided by quarter-end invested capital. No tax adjustment is applied.

cash.notes: Latest SEC cash or cash-and-equivalent balance fact.

debt.notes: Latest available SEC debt fact. This may include capital/finance lease obligations depending on the SEC tag.

debt.notes: Latest available SEC debt fact. This may include capital/finance lease obligations depending on the SEC tag.

cash.notes: Latest SEC cash or cash-and-equivalent balance fact.

ebitda.notes: Input recovered from the previous stored valuation and its reference price.

forward_eps_public.notes: Yahoo expected EPS per listed share in USD; estimate methodology is not independently verified.

forward_eps_proxy.notes: Saved trailing EPS per listed share grown by 3-year EPS CAGR; not analyst consensus.

revenue_growth_yoy.notes: Quarterly revenue YoY growth for Q2 versus the same fiscal quarter last year.

revenue_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter 3-year CAGR computed from SEC Q2 revenue facts. Latest quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Prior-year quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Q2/Q3 single-quarter values may be derived from year-to-date 10-Q/6-K facts; Q4 may be derived from annual facts minus Q3 year-to-date facts.

eps_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter diluted EPS 3-year CAGR computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

free_cash_flow.notes: Latest-quarter free_cash_flow: Quarterly free cash flow computed as operating cash flow minus capex.

fcf_margin.notes: Free cash flow TTM divided by revenue TTM, expressed as a percentage.

roe.notes: Latest-quarter roe: Annualized quarterly net income divided by quarter-end equity.

roic.notes: Latest-quarter roic: Proxy annualized quarterly ROIC: operating income divided by quarter-end invested capital. No tax adjustment is applied.

cash.notes: Latest SEC cash or cash-and-equivalent balance fact.

debt.notes: Latest available SEC debt fact. This may include capital/finance lease obligations depending on the SEC tag.

debt_to_equity.notes: Latest debt divided by latest stockholders' equity.

eps_gaap_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

pe.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved net_income in the listing currency.

forward_pe.notes: Current price divided by saved expected EPS from Yahoo or its implied forward P/E input; not an SEC fact.

peg.notes: peg: Positive 3-year EPS CAGR was unavailable; PEG is not meaningful.

price_to_sales.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved revenue in the listing currency.

ev_to_ebitda.notes: Current enterprise value divided by saved EBITDA in the listing currency.

fcf_yield.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved free_cash_flow in the listing currency.

free_cash_flow_ttm.notes: Operating cash flow TTM minus capex TTM. Capex is treated as a positive cash outflow.

pe_ttm.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved net_income in the listing currency.

price_to_sales_ttm.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved revenue in the listing currency.

forward_pe_proxy.notes: forward_pe_proxy: Positive 3-year EPS CAGR or trailing EPS was unavailable; forward P/E proxy is not meaningful.

forward_pe_public_estimate.notes: Current price divided by saved expected EPS from Yahoo or its implied forward P/E input; not an SEC fact.

peg_proxy.notes: peg: Positive 3-year EPS CAGR was unavailable; PEG is not meaningful.

eps_growth_3y_proxy.notes: eps_cagr_3y: GAAP EPS remains loss-making (latest -2.11); GAAP EPS growth is not meaningful.

ev_to_ebitda_proxy.notes: Current enterprise value divided by saved EBITDA in the listing currency.

ebitda_proxy.notes: Proxy EBITDA: operating income plus depreciation/amortization where SEC facts are available.

enterprise_value_proxy.notes: Current market cap plus saved debt minus saved cash in the listing currency.

fcf_margin_ttm.notes: Free cash flow TTM divided by revenue TTM, expressed as a percentage.

fcf_margin.notes: Free cash flow TTM divided by revenue TTM, expressed as a percentage.
